newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lane Crawford shrs up on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Lane Crawford shrs up on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shares in Lane Crawford International Ltd ended sharply higher on Wednesday, boosted by late buying on hopes of better earnings prospects, brokers said.
Lane Crawford "A" shares rose HK$0.85, or 6.56, percent, to end at HK$13.80 on volume of 116,000 shares.

"Some small to medium size funds are buying the shares on hopes of better earnings prospects after the company said it would close its operation in Singapore," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. Analysts said Lane Crawford's earnings should benefit in the long run from the closure of its loss-making shop in Singapore. -- HK Newsroom (852)2843-6370
